title: Where the Leviton Decora Smart HomeKit and Matter codes are
description: Leviton prints the Gen 2 HomeKit QR code in the lower right corner behind the wall plate. After the Matter firmware update the sticker stops working and the Matter code comes from the My Leviton app.
lede: Take the wall plate off. Leviton prints the code in the lower right corner of the device, and after the Matter update it moves into the app.

rows.term: Gen 2 Wi-Fi, lost box and manual
rows.text: Leviton: a QR code can be found in the lower right corner. Remove the wall plate, scan the code, replace the wall plate.
Or when a Gen 2 code will not scan: choose Use the HomeKit Setup Code in the Home app and type the 8 digit code from the lower right corner of the device, with the wall plate removed.

rows.term: After the Matter update (firmware 2.1.0 and later)
rows.text: The old HomeKit QR cannot be used. The device must be re-added to Apple Home with the Matter code from the My Leviton app.

rows.term: The Matter code in the app
rows.text: You can always retrieve your Matter QR pairing code using Device Settings in the My Leviton app. It is unique per device, can be saved as an image, and is used with any Matter enabled controller for the first setup.
